method.decoder_reuse: All identical RTSP logical channels share one DecChannel; USB is a second physical source.

metric_definitions.infer_fps: Successful tasks / observed window seconds; composite tasks are six-model batches.
metric_definitions.publish_fps: Updates to latest result slot; not rendered video FPS.
metric_definitions.queue_worker_ms: Queue + worker mean weighted by successful tasks, excludes capture/decode/render/network/client.
metric_definitions.cpu_percent: Engine utime+stime; 100% equals one logical CPU core.
metric_definitions.decoded_frames: Includes warmup and connection time; not a measurement-window FPS.

limitations: Live sources differ between runs; finite-window fluctuation is not a proof of strict zero regression.
Logical channel matrix is not an independent-camera decoding capacity test.
YOLOv5n and YOLOv5 Seg have 80-class outputs but three-line user label files; performance does not validate class semantics.
YOLO26 Pose weights unavailable; seven adapters covered by CPU dispatch checks, six families by hardware matrix.
No end-to-end percentiles, full RSS/PSS/CMA curves, unified drop ratio or long-term stability validation.
Weights and camera content are not publicly redistributed; source/config/result evidence does not guarantee identical third-party numbers.
